mapper.sql: pl.id, pl.plan_date, pl.product_id, p.code AS product_code, p.name AS product_name, pl.planned_qty, pl.received_qty, pl.source, pl.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM erp_inbound_plan pl JOIN erp_product p ON p.id = pl.product_id WHERE pl.plan_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY pl.plan_date, p.code
SELECT pl.id, pl.plan_date, pl.product_id, pl.planned_qty, pl.received_qty, pl.source, pl.updated_at FROM erp_inbound_plan pl WHERE pl.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_inbound_plan SET received_qty = received_qty + #{qty}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE erp_inbound_plan SET planned_qty = #{plannedQty}, source = #{source}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_inbound_plan (plan_date, product_id, planned_qty, received_qty, source, updated_at) VALUES (#{planDate}, #{productId}, #{plannedQty}, #{receivedQty}, #{source}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
